steps.content: RAWR—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Damn it!!
A terrifying behemoth opens its massive jaws, unleashing a deafening roar that threatens to shatter the entire cavern—it's the Dread Dragon, the final boss you must defeat.

Etti didn't even add a save function to this game!!! Good grief... After trudging through this endless dungeon and slaying monsters left and right, you finally reach the last stage. At this point, both you and the boss are running low on HP. You mustn't get defeated here!
Otherwise, the mountain of paperwork at the Bureau tomorrow will be just like this cursed dragon, ready to sink its claws into you when you least expect it—

steps.speaker: Dread Dragon
steps.content: Roarrrr—!
The cunning Dread Dragon lunges at you as you hesitate—

options: Swing your sword at the dragon

steps.content: Before the Dread Dragon can strike with its claws, your sword slashes away its final ounce of HP. With one last furious roar, the massive beast comes crashing down.
Ding dong—
"Congratulations! You've defeated the epic final boss Dread Dragon and cleared the level."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Phew... finally cleared that level. All that monster-slaying and leveling up didn't go to waste.
"Rewards unlocked: [Dreadlord Etti's Commemorative Coin] [Dreadlord Etti's Crown] [Etti's Wishing Bottle]..."
[Wishing Bottle]... [Commemorative Coin]... You can't help but notice that these rewards are all just Etti merchandise. This boss certainly has a big ego...
What's that little paper head of yours thinking, Chief?
A familiar voice rings out as pink smoke fills the cave. Your vision becomes obscured, and all you can hear are the dragon cries echoing from within the narrow cavern.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Etti?
A bone-chilling roar pierces the air as a pink and black figure streaks toward you like lightning, giving you no time to dodge...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Ta-da!
The smoke instantly clears, revealing a triumphant Etti. Having shed her fearsome dragon form, she now bounces around cheerfully in her adorable chibi appearance.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Congratulations on clearing the level, Chief! Your rewards will be personally presented by none other than the Dread Dragon Etti herself. But... It seems one treasure has already found its way to your feet!
Etti giggles as you freeze in surprise. Looking down, you find a plump, pink little dragon coiled around your leg, staring into your puzzled eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What the...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: This is my companion, Drakeling. By beating the game, you've proven yourself worthy of our dragon clan's friendship. From now on, this little one will also be your loyal companion! Now, Drakeling, be good to Chief!

steps.speaker: Drakeling
steps.content: Purr...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Now then, let's open your next grand prize! What could it be... An endless supply of gold coins? A legendary traveler's journal? Or perhaps a rare dragon bloodstone?
Etti savors the moment, visibly delighted as she draws out the suspense before finally lifting the treasure chest's lid. In the next instant, she freezes in place.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: It's gone?! How could this...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Etti, look over there, isn't that...

Hearing your words, Etti spins around to look. Dashing away at full speed is a duckling in bizarre armor. Its fluffy bottom wiggles as it waddles off, somehow managing to carry a massive treasure chest brimming with gold coins!

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content:
Quack, quack quack quack! 
(Oh no, I've been spotted!)

steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack! 
(Quick, let's make a run for it with the treasures!)

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Uh... What were they quacking about?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Aaaah—Those little rascals, how dare they steal MY treasures! Chief, try to make Drakeling fly! We have to catch up to them! We must get back the treasure they stole!!!
